name: LongSnag
collider: capsule/simplified mesh around trunk (+fork for b); twigs and stubs no collider
notes: Pivot at the bottom of the root flare; the soft root-flare collar goes 0.24 m below the ground line (sink when placing). Leafless dead snag. Material per object: Birch (upper trunk, stubs, twigs), Bark (dark old base sleeve + surface roots), Props (splintered heartwood of broken top: grey_wood; stub ends: end_grain_grey), Moss (drape on the root flare). Tiny trunk sway in Wind UV2.
